_comment: Every quest in the game. A quest belongs to one area and has ordered steps; the player's position in it is a step index, the same model the main story used before quests existed (docs/DESIGN.md sections 30 and 34). Completing `gauntlet_requirement` of them is what makes the Elder's Gauntlet challengeable. Map objects move quests on: see the `quest`, `quest_text`, `sets_step` and `completes_quest` keys in data/maps/*.json.
default_objective: Follow the path north, out of the clearing.

quests.name: The Dry Cut
quests.summary: Aldenmere's well is low and the channel that feeds it has been dry eleven days. The mere it drains has not dropped an inch.

steps.objective: Ask in Aldenmere what is wrong with the water.
Take the fen road north, toward the mere.
Get past the sluice and reach the shore.
Find what the mere is holding.
Carry what you found back to Aldenmere.

quests.name: The Weight of the Lock
quests.summary: [PLACEHOLDER] The sluice gate on the fen road is sound in every part but one: the counterweight that turns it is gone.

steps.objective: [PLACEHOLDER] Look around the works under the sluice.
[PLACEHOLDER] Find something the counterweight could be made from.
[PLACEHOLDER] Take the iron to the founder in Aldenmere.
[PLACEHOLDER] Hang the new weight in the cradle under the sluice.

quests.name: What Denned in the Kiln
quests.summary: [PLACEHOLDER] Something cinder-built has moved into Emberwick Row's kiln, and the village cannot fire anything while it's there.

steps.objective: [PLACEHOLDER] Find out why the kiln has gone cold.
[PLACEHOLDER] Clear whatever has denned in the brush south of the kiln.
